lines.en: We move closer to the water, but not close enough for it to catch us too.
lines.zh: 我们朝水更近的地方挪了挪,但还没近到让它也抓住我们的程度。

lines.en: Part of me wishes that it would — but that the water would bend in a way that spares the girl beside me so I can witness its tidal wrath in a manner that renders me permanently breathless.
lines.zh: 我有一部分希望它会——但希望那水会弯出一个弧度,饶过我身边的女孩,好让我亲眼见证它的潮怒,见证到让我永远喘不上气。

lines.en: Suffice it to say, I’d take that over her and everyone else always emptying out my lungs.
lines.zh: 这么说吧,比起她和所有人一次次排空我的肺,我宁愿选那个。

lines.en: Even when it’s quiet like this, when our minds are both so obviously elsewhere, I’m always aware.
lines.zh: 即使像此刻这般安静,即使我们的心思都明显在别处,我也始终警醒。

lines.en: Of how easily she could suffocate me...
lines.zh: 想到她要多容易就能让我窒息……

lines.en: Of how her hands, clasped tightly around her knees, feel more like they’re curled around my neck. And how fighting a war against myself has made me too exhausted to even ask her to stop.
lines.zh: 想到她紧紧抱膝的双手,感觉更像是扣在我的脖颈上。想到和我自己打的那场仗,已让我疲惫到连求她住口都做不到。

lines.en: : Well...looks like it’s just you and me again.
lines.zh: : 嗯……看来又是只有你和我了。

lines.en: : Guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : You worried too?
lines.zh: : 你也在担心?

lines.en: : They’ll figure it out.
lines.zh: : 她们会想明白的。

lines.en: : I think so too.
lines.zh: : 我也这么想。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll happen if we just keep telling ourselves that.
lines.zh: : 只要我们一直这么告诉自己,我相信那天就会来。

lines.en: : It’s typically the opposite in my experience.
lines.zh: : 以我的经验,通常恰恰相反。

lines.en: : Yeah...same.
lines.zh: : 是啊……一样。

lines.en: : Maybe we should keep telling ourselves that they’re going to break up then? If fate and hope and all those other vague, optimistic adjectives are so commonly in disagreement with us, I mean.
lines.zh: : 那也许,我们该一直告诉自己她们会分手?毕竟命运、希望,和那些含糊的乐观形容词,总是和我们意见相左。

lines.en: : I think doing that would just make us bad friends.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样做,只会让我们变成坏朋友。

lines.en: : True...
lines.zh: : 也是……

lines.en: : Guess we’re kind of fucked either way then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那看来无论怎样,我们都有点完蛋,嗯?

lines.en: : Guess so. But at the end of the day, it’s those two who are way more fucked than either of us right now. We’re only fucked by-proxy.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。但说到底,眼下比我们俩完蛋得多的是那两位。我们只是「被连带地」完蛋。

lines.en: : Well, hey. I’d take that over not getting fucked at all, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 嗯,嘿。要我说,被连带地完蛋,好过压根没人来「完蛋」我——你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...just to clarify, that was supposed to be more of a joke than one more act of pressuring you into screwing me. Just...trying to lighten the mood.
lines.zh: : 呃……澄清一下,那本来更像句玩笑,而不是又一次逼你上我的施压。只是……想活跃一下气氛。

lines.en: : I know. Plus, even if I did take that the wrong way, you’d get to fall back on the excuse of being drunk. You can’t lose.
lines.zh: : 我知道。再说,就算我真会错意,你也还有「喝多了」这个台阶。你稳赢不输。

lines.en: : I guess I am a little tipsy, yeah. I was kind of just hamming it up for Wakana’s sake, though.
lines.zh: : 我确实有点微醺,是的。不过我那多半是演给 Wakana 看的。

lines.en: : You felt it too, right? How...I don’t know...fragile she seemed?
lines.zh: : 你也感觉到了,对吧?她那种……怎么说……脆弱的感觉?

lines.en: : I’m not sure I would have if you didn’t point something out when we first got here. She’s even better at hiding her feelings than I am and I’ve essentially built my entire character around that.
lines.zh: : 要不是刚到时你指了一句,我未必会察觉。她藏情绪的本事比我还高,而我整个人设,基本就是围着这项本事搭起来的。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. You two are really similar.
lines.zh: : 嗯,是。你们俩真的很像。

lines.en: : Talented, gloomy intellectuals who make it hard for you to get close to them...but also the type of people who will silently cherish you for the rest of your life whether you want them to or not.
lines.zh: : 有才华、阴郁、让你难以靠近的知识分子……但也是那种,无论你愿不愿意,都会默默把你珍视余生的人。

lines.en: : I wish I met you sooner. Both of you. I’d have loved having people like that growing up.
lines.zh: : 真希望我早点遇见你们。你们两个。成长路上要是有这样的人就好了。

lines.en: : How are you doing, Senpai? Like...really doing?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗,Senpai?我是说……真的还好吗?

lines.en: : I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 我也说不准。

lines.en: : “Confused” is probably the best word right now.
lines.zh: : 「困惑」大概是现在最贴切的词。

lines.en: : About what?
lines.zh: : 困惑什么?

lines.en: : It’s hard to say. Leaving the house is like playing a game of roulette at this point.
lines.zh: : 很难说。到了这一步,出门就像玩一场轮盘赌。

lines.en: : Sometimes, something good will happen. Sometimes, something terrible. But it’s those terrible days I focus on the most because there’s like a...voice in the back of my mind telling me that’s what I deserve.
lines.zh: : 有时,会发生点好事。有时,会发生可怕的事。但我最放不下的偏偏是那些糟糕的日子——因为我脑海深处有个……声音,告诉我那才是我应得的。

lines.en: : At the same time, though, I’m trying to change for Ami’s sake. And that’s...hard. I’m not good when it comes to changing.
lines.zh: : 但与此同时,我在为了 Ami 试着改变。而这……很难。一涉及改变,我就不行。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, Senpai...I think you’ve changed a lot since you left school. It’s not normal for you to just tell me things without putting up some sort of fight first.
lines.zh: : 不管有没有用,Senpai……我觉得你离开学校之后改变了很多。不加任何挣扎就把话直接告诉我,这可不像你。

lines.en: : I don’t have the energy to fight anymore. All I want to do is sleep.
lines.zh: : 我已经没有力气挣扎了。我只想睡觉。

lines.en: : Senpai. Look at me for a second.
lines.zh: : Senpai。看我一眼。

lines.en: : I got you.
lines.zh: : 我罩着你。

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗?

lines.en: : I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : Everyone does.
lines.zh: : 谁都会说。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’m not everyone. I’m your loyal kouhai and best friend who can be anything you need her to be. Just say the word and I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 对,但我不是「谁都会」。我是你忠诚的学妹、你最好的朋友,你需要我是什么,我就可以是什么。你一句话,我就办。

lines.en: : Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani——

lines.en: : Need some cash for dinner? I got you. Someone to walk the dog you don’t have? Again, I got you.
lines.zh: : 晚饭缺点钱?我罩你。需要人遛你那条不存在的狗?我照样罩你。

lines.en: : Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani——

lines.en: : Quickie in the closet before class? I got you, man.
lines.zh: : 上课前在储物间来一发?我也罩你,老兄。

lines.en: : Imani, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Imani,我能问你一件事吗?

lines.en: : Of course, Senpai. You can ask me anything.
lines.zh: : 当然,Senpai。你什么都能问我。

lines.en: : Why don’t you ever wear a swimsuit?
lines.zh: : 你为什么从来不穿泳衣?

lines.en: : Is...that really relevant right now? I thought you were in the process of like, telling me about your feelings and stuff?
lines.zh: : 这……真的和眼下有关吗?我还以为你在,那个,跟我讲你的感受之类的?

lines.en: : Then I feel like there’s a part of you I’m still missing — something you’re not telling me because you’re worried of how I’ll react. And I don’t think that’s really fair.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得,你身上还有一部分我没见到——有件事你不说,是担心我的反应。而我觉得,那不太公平。

lines.en: : I mean...how is it unfair? You do the same shit, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 就是说……哪里不公平了?你不也干同样的事吗,Senpai。

lines.en: : I know...I have a lot to work on.
lines.zh: : 我知道……我要改的很多。

lines.en: : But I want to tell you all of those things because I want you to understand the type of person you are to me. I want to be a better friend. I just...haven’t figured out how yet.
lines.zh: : 但我想把那些全都告诉你,因为我想让你明白,你对我来说是怎样的人。我想做一个更好的朋友。我只是……还没想明白怎么做。

lines.en: : Well, it’s the same for me...Just my thing doesn’t really have anything to do with our friendship.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我也一样……只是我的那件事,和我们的友情没什么关系。

lines.en: : Of course it does. Not telling me shows that you don’t fully trust me.
lines.zh: : 当然有关系。不说,就说明你没有完全信任我。

lines.en: : Trust doesn’t have anything to do with it, okay? I know you won’t think any differently of me. I’m just...embarrassed, I guess. Or maybe, like...ashamed? I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 这和信任没关系,好吗?我知道你不会因此对我改观。我只是……难为情,我猜。或者……羞耻?我不知道。

lines.en: : I don’t like swimsuits. I don’t like...revealing myself.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢泳衣。我不喜欢……暴露自己。

lines.en: : And I don’t like voicing my problems to people but that’s practically all I’ve been doing lately.
lines.zh: : 我也不喜欢把自己的问题说给人听,可最近我干的基本全是这个。

lines.en: : Also, you’d kind of have to reveal your body to me if we ever had sex. So...there’s that.
lines.zh: : 另外,我们要是真做爱,你多少也得向我露出身体。所以……还有这么一条。

lines.en: : Not if we keep the lights off!~
lines.zh: : 关着灯不就行了嘛!~

lines.en: : But also, if we kept the lights off, you might not be able to find me at all and would wind up fucking my couch or something. Which would be wild since I don’t even have a couch.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来,真关了灯,你可能连我都找不到,最后上了我的沙发之类的东西。那可就离谱了——毕竟我连沙发都没有。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Okay...I’ll tell you.
lines.zh: : 好……我告诉你。

lines.en: : But I have a condition.
lines.zh: : 但我有一个条件。

lines.en: : And what’s that?
lines.zh: : 什么条件?

lines.en: : You can’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 你不许说任何话。

lines.en: : I’m not going to tell anyone, Imani. I-
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉任何人,Imani。我——

lines.en: : No- I don’t mean it like that, Senpai. I mean...I want you to just...sit there and listen. No sympathy or...encouragement or...anything like that. I just want to get it over with.
lines.zh: : 不——我不是那个意思,Senpai。我是说……我要你只是……坐在那里听着。不要同情,也不要……鼓励,或者……任何类似的东西。我只想把这事赶紧熬过去。

lines.en: Imani gets up and heads over to where the water meets the land.
lines.zh: Imani 站起身,走向水与陆地相接的地方。

lines.en: The moonlight accentuates her beauty, but I know it’s fleeting as I can tell that she is about to do everything in her power to cast one more shadow on it.
lines.zh: 月光勾勒着她的美,但我知道那转瞬即逝——我看得出来,她即将竭尽所能,再往那份美上投下一道阴影。

lines.en: : I’ll also be expecting at least one deep, dark secret from you in return. Got it?
lines.zh: : 作为交换,我也期待你交出一个很深、很黑的秘密。明白吗?

lines.en: : You mean one you haven’t probably already heard from Wakana and Osako?
lines.zh: : 你是说一个你大概还没从 Wakana 和 Osako 那里听过的?

lines.en: : Senpai, I-
lines.zh: : Senpai,我——

lines.en: : No. If I’m not going to comment on your thing, you’re not going to comment on mine. That’s my condition.
lines.zh: : 不。我不评论你的事,你也不许评论我的。这是我的条件。

lines.en: : Mm...okay. Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好。公道。

lines.en: : Welcome to Imani Imai’s impromptu story time...she says, pretending to have not rehearsed this conversation a hundred times already.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到 Imani Imai 的临时故事会……她说道,假装这段对话没有在脑子里排练过一百遍。

lines.en: : So, you may not have noticed this as it’s really hard to pick up on, but I’m actually black.
lines.zh: : 那么,你可能没注意到这一点——因为它实在难以察觉——但我其实是黑人。

lines.en: : What? Really?
lines.zh: : 什么?真的?

lines.en: : Shush. No jokes either. Let me use them all to clear the air.
lines.zh: : 嘘。也不许开玩笑。让我把笑话都留着自己用,先把话说清。

lines.en: : So yes, in a shocking turn of events, I am black. But, as I’ve mentioned in the past, I’m half-Japanese as well.
lines.zh: : 所以是的,剧情惊人反转,我是黑人。但正如我以前提过的,我也是半个日本人。

lines.en: : A bastard child, if you will. A product of my mother’s infidelity and the insatiable lust of a foreign tourist who didn’t know how to pull out on time.
lines.zh: : 你可以叫我私生女。我母亲出轨的产物,外加一个不懂得按时抽退的外国游客那贪得无厌的欲火的结晶。

lines.en: : Despite all of that, though...despite knowing that none of his blood flowed within me, my father raised me as if I was his own.
lines.zh: : 尽管如此……尽管明知他的血没有一滴流在我身上,我父亲还是把我当亲生女儿养大。

lines.en: : He taught me about God....How all men and women are created equal and how each and every one of them is deserving of love. And that really stuck with me. Sans the God part.
lines.zh: : 他教我认识神……教我人人生而平等,每个人都值得被爱。这话我记到了今天。除了神那部分。

lines.en: : I just wish it stuck with his other children.
lines.zh: : 我只希望,这些话也能留在他的其他孩子心里。

lines.en: : You see...they never saw me the way he did. And they spared no effort at all in reminding me of that every chance they got. All behind the scenes, though. At least at first.
lines.zh: : 你看……他们从来不曾像他那样看我。而且一有机会,就不遗余力地提醒我这一点。不过都在幕后。至少一开始是。

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time until everyone in school knew what I really was. Which meant it was only a matter of time until my mother started getting shit as well. And rightly so, might I add.
lines.zh: : 全校知道我「真正是什么」只是时间问题。这也就意味着,我母亲开始被人指指点点,同样只是时间问题。而且我补一句,活该。

lines.en: : You know, the only way I’ve ever really related to her at all was in the fact that we were both relentlessly trashed by our peers over a one night stand she made.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我和她真正产生共鸣的唯一一点,是我们在一场她的一夜情之后,都被同辈人穷追不舍地糟蹋。

lines.en: : Just I wasn’t really there to do anything about it on account of still being a little Japanese tadpole at the time.
lines.zh: : 只不过当时我还是一只小小的日本蝌蚪,根本没资格做任何回应。

lines.en: : But regardless, I was bullied. She was bullied. And every day, my father would pull me aside and reassure me that this was only temporary.
lines.zh: : 但无论如何,我被霸凌。她被霸凌。而每天,父亲都会把我拉到一旁,安慰我说,这一切都只是暂时的。

lines.en: : That I was the same as everyone else and that they would all see that one day.
lines.zh: : 说我和所有人一样,说总有一天大家都会看到这一点。

lines.en: : So I’d smile. Tell him I love him — which I did. I loved him so much. And in hindsight, he’s probably the only thing that kept me going.
lines.zh: : 于是我会笑。说我爱他——我也是真心的。我非常爱他。事后想想,他大概就是唯一支撑我走下去的东西。

lines.en: : It started off with just name calling. Sansa ni...idiot. Ko’hweni...useless. Ahbwah...animal. Ashawo...whore.
lines.zh: : 一开始只是骂名字。Sansa ni……白痴。Ko'hweni……废物。Ahbwah……畜生。Ashawo……婊子。

lines.en: : And my personal favorite, ching chong fuo, which is a Twi slur for the Chinese. Fucking morons didn’t even know what type of Asian I was.
lines.zh: : 还有我的最爱——ching chong fuo,一句针对中国人的特威语蔑称。那群蠢货甚至不知道我是哪一种亚洲人。

lines.en: : Ignoring insults is easy, though. So I focused more on educating myself than giving into all of the bullying since I wanted to make my father proud.
lines.zh: : 不过,无视辱骂还算容易。于是我更专注于自学,而不是屈服于铺天盖地的霸凌——因为我想让父亲骄傲。

lines.en: : But, here’s a thing I wish I knew sooner.
lines.zh: : 但有件事,我真希望早点知道。

lines.en: : Bullies really don’t like it when you’re smart.
lines.zh: : 霸凌者非常不喜欢你聪明。

lines.en: : One day, a bunch of kids from my school got together for a party to celebrate the end of the year. And, being the stupid and fearless specimen I am, I decided to go check it out.
lines.zh: : 有一天,学校的一群孩子凑在一起办派对,庆祝学年结束。而我这种又蠢又天不怕地不怕的样本,决定去凑个热闹。

lines.en: : I mean, it wasn’t like I didn’t have any friends. There were a handful who’d stick up for me from time to time before tapering off from the consequent ostracization they’d receive in return.
lines.zh: : 我是说,我也不是没有朋友。有几个会时不时替我说话,然后因为随之而来的排挤,慢慢疏远了我。

lines.en: : So I found a few of them, got some food, got some drinks...started talking. And then there was this boy who came up to me.
lines.zh: : 于是我找到了他们中的几个,拿了吃的,拿了喝的……聊了起来。然后有个男孩朝我走了过来。

lines.en: : His name was Kwesi — popular kid. Some relation to the mayor or...some other comparable noteworthy position like that. And we started talking.
lines.zh: : 他叫 Kwesi——受欢迎的孩子。和市长沾亲带故,或者……某个类似的显赫身份。我们聊了起来。

lines.en: : He told me how beautiful my eyes were...refilled my drinks and wound up buying me dessert from some stall not far from where all of us were hanging out.
lines.zh: : 他夸我的眼睛有多漂亮……给我续杯,最后还从离我们不远的一个小摊上,买来了甜点。

lines.en: : He seemed nice. And it was a party, so I thought...what the hell? I’m gonna let this guy run some bases.
lines.zh: : 他看起来人不错。又是派对,所以我想……管他呢?就让这家伙跑几垒吧。

lines.en: : I’d already messed around with some other boys by then, so it’s not like I was totally inexperienced or anything.
lines.zh: : 那之前我已经和别的男孩胡闹过,所以也不算全无经验什么的。

lines.en: : So he takes me back to his place, right? Really nice house up on a hill that overlooked the rest of the village. I still remember how beautiful the lights were from the window of his bedroom.
lines.zh: : 于是他带我回他家,对吧?山上很漂亮的一栋房子,能俯瞰整个村子。我至今记得从他卧室窗户望出去,那些灯火有多美。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, that memory is somewhat soiled for me by what comes after.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是,那之后发生的事,把这段记忆也弄得有点脏了。

lines.en: : Which brings us back to the main question. Why don’t I ever wear a swimsuit? And unfortunately, the answer kind of sucks.
lines.zh: : 这就把我们带回最初的问题。我为什么不穿泳衣?而不幸的是,答案有点烂。

lines.en: : Kwesi tied me up. I agreed, thinking it might be fun. But I probably wouldn’t have agreed had I known that he would subsequently invite another six of his friends into the room.
lines.zh: : Kwesi 把我绑了起来。我同意了,以为那样也许好玩。但要是早知道他随后会再叫六个朋友进房间,我多半就不会同意了。

lines.en: : One of them was my brother.
lines.zh: : 其中一个,是我哥哥。

lines.en: : And so I immediately looked at him with tears welling up in my eyes, knowing that there was no way in hell that this wasn’t going to end horribly for me. But that motherfucker just looked away...
lines.zh: : 于是我立刻看向他,泪水在眼里打转,心知这一切绝不可能不以最惨烈的方式在我身上收场。但那个狗娘养的,只是把头别开了……

lines.en: : They used scissors to cut off my clothes...wrote some things on my body I never bothered looking at since I’d already heard every insult possible by then. But that was just the beginning.
lines.zh: : 他们用剪刀剪开我的衣服……在我身上写了些字,我从来懒得去看——到那时为止,世上可能的辱骂我早就听全了。但这只是开始。

lines.en: : And leaving out the middle part, which I’m not going to burden you with, all that’s left is the grand finale.
lines.zh: : 中间那部分我不打算让你背负,略过不表,剩下的就是压轴大戏。

lines.en: : And the reason I like it best in the dark.
lines.zh: : 也是我最喜欢黑暗的原因。

lines.en: : One of Kwesi’s friends boiled some water. A lot of it. Can’t remember why specifically, but I think it had something to do with not being able to get the writing off.
lines.zh: : Kwesi 的一个朋友烧了些水。很多水。具体原因我记不清了,但我记得和「字迹擦不掉」有关。

lines.en: : They threw it at me. Several pots worth, to be exact. One boy even used an electric kettle. Like, for real man?
lines.zh: : 他们把水泼向我。准确地说,好几锅的量。有个男孩甚至用了电热水壶。不是,哥,认真的?

lines.en: : And yeah! Turns out the human body handles boiling water just as well as you’d expect it to. And the evidence of that is written all over me.
lines.zh: : 对!事实证明,人体对付沸水的表现,和你预期的一样好。而证据,写满了我全身。

lines.en: : It wasn’t until the damage had already been done that they realized they’d gone too far. Well...one of them, at least.
lines.zh: : 直到伤害已经铸成,他们才意识到自己玩过头了。嗯……至少其中一个是。

lines.en: : Maybe the words of my father just took a little longer to reach him than they should have, but my brother eventually ran off to call for help.
lines.zh: : 也许父亲的话只是迟到了一点才抵达他心里,但我哥哥最终跑出去求救了。

lines.en: : I spent three weeks in the hospital after that. And while I don’t look nearly as bad now as I did the first few years, I still can’t look at myself without thinking of what happened that night.
lines.zh: : 那之后,我住了三周院。虽然现在我看起来远没有头几年那么糟,但我还是没法看着镜子里的自己,不想起那一夜发生的事。

lines.en: : At least one good thing came of it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,至少有一件好事因此而生。

lines.en: : When school started the next year...no one ever bullied me again.
lines.zh: : 第二年开学……再也没有人霸凌过我。

lines.en: : Thank you for remaining quiet and not battering me with sympathy. I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你保持安静,没有用同情把我轰成筛子。我很感激。

lines.en: : May I speak now?
lines.zh: : 现在我可以说话了吗?

lines.en: : Yes, Senpai. You may speak.
lines.zh: : 可以,Senpai。你可以说话了。

lines.en: : Did you bring it with you?
lines.zh: : 你把它带来了吗?

lines.en: : Yes...
lines.zh: : 带了……

lines.en: : Can you show me?
lines.zh: : 能给我看看吗?

lines.en: : Yes...
